claim_policy: These are source-level seed definitions. Operational M3 requires proof that independent domains are owned/delegated and returning live peer records.

seeds.notes: Existing NetCoin domain; not sufficient for independent M3 by itself.
Use for non-AWS/operator diversity once domain is owned.
Use for independent DNS rotation only after ownership is confirmed.

minimum_operational_m3.aws_account_limit: no more than half of seed records should resolve only to founder AWS nodes
